_help: Copy to <domain>.json (e.g. health.json), fill in, run: python -m seed.taxonomy_seed
levels: name of each tree depth, top first. Node codes join into paths like 01.A.
variants (optional): children added to every node at apply_to_level, e.g. livelihoods tracks.
sdgs are numbers; sectors are slugs from common.json; adds maps a variant or modifier code to extra SDGs.
To rename or split a cell, give the new node a 'replaces' list of old slugs; removed cells are deprecated, never deleted.
Set status to 'draft' to load the tree for review without showing it in the product.
label: Health
